rationale: Public records show a 2011 tax-default auction listing and residential land-use classifications through 2024, but these do not prove vacancy or occupancy. No current direct occupancy evidence or vacancy start date was established.

evidence.detail: Redfin identifies the address as a single-family home and reports its last recorded sale on June 24, 1992. The page does not expose a date for its Street View image.

Alameda County's Treasurer-Tax Collector report lists APN 4-85-8 / 1115 Center St among properties subject to tax-default sale. This indicates tax delinquency, not vacancy; whether it sold is not established by the cited entry.
Oakland lists the parcel as code 1100, single-family residential homes used as such. This land-use classification does not verify actual occupancy.
A later City attachment lists the same parcel and address as code 1100, single-family residential homes used as such. This land-use classification does not verify actual occupancy.

report_md: See docs/research/NOO-71-1115-center-st-oakland.md. Vacancy start and duration are not established. The BARN queue RPC was not submitted because the required BARN_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is unavailable in this environment.
